description: Land Acquisition - Poththukkulama, Pallama D/S Division, Puttalam District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition for a public purpose (Pallama Divisional Secretariat office). While it mentions a minister's name and title, the core content focuses exclusively on land matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
